title_en: If I were you, I’d take a break.
goal_ko: 조언을 구하고, If I were you로 조언하고, 조언에 답하기

expressions.pattern: ^(?:(?:[a-z]+ ){2,15})?(?:so )?(?:what should i do|what do you think i should do|any advice|what would you do)(?: about (?:it|this|that|[a-z ]{2,30}))?$
expressions.accept_note: 앞에 고민을 붙여 말해도 목표 수행(I’m always late. What should I do?).

ok: I always forget my umbrella. What should I do?

help.blank: If I ___ you, I’d take a break.

expressions.pattern: ^if i (?:were|was) you (?:id|i would) (?<x>[a-z]+(?: [a-z]+){0,8})$|^(?:id|i would) (?<y>[a-z]+(?: [a-z]+){0,8}) if i (?:were|was) you$
partial_patterns: ^(?:you should|maybe you should|why dont you|id|i would) [a-z]+(?: [a-z]+){0,8}$
expressions.accept_note: ‘If I was you’도 인정(구어). ‘You should …’·‘I’d …’만은 뜻 전달(부분).

ok: If I were you, I’d take a break.
if i was you i would talk to your boss
I’d ask for help if I were you

scene.en: I’m always tired these days. What should I do?
If I were you, I’d go to bed earlier.
That’s a good idea. Thanks, Tori!
I have a problem, too. I can’t wake up early.
If I were you, I’d put your alarm far away.

story_notice_ko: 토리의 고민에 조언해 줘요. 정답은 없어요.

story.en: I want to learn Spanish, but I’m always busy. What should I do?
story.screen_hint_ko: 조언해요: If I were you, I’d ___. (study on the bus, use an app)

ask_me.en: Now tell me a small problem. Then ask me what to do.
ask_me.screen_hint_ko: 작은 고민을 말하고 물어봐요(꾸며도 돼요). 예: I’m always late. What should I do?

branches.say: If I were you, I’d take it one step at a time.

privacy_ko: 고민은 기억에 남기지 않아요. 무거운 고민은 공통 민감 규칙. 토리는 의료·법·돈 문제에 전문 조언을 하지 않아요.
